{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the sales data, ensuring revenue is parsed as float
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string with commas to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders as they don't contribute to revenue
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the average revenue per customer in each segment
segment_avg_revenue = sales_df.groupby('customer_segment')['revenue'].mean()

# Print the average revenue per segment
segment_avg_revenue"}
